# Lyfie

Lyfie is an open-source organization building fully free, Docker-first, self-hosted software.

## Key Links
- Website: https://lyfie.org
- GitHub: https://github.com/lyfie-org
- Luthor: https://luthor.fyi
- Papyra: https://papyra.app
- Founder: https://rahulnsanand.com

## Summary
Lyfie builds privacy-respecting tools that avoid paywalls and vendor lock-in. The mission is to deliver high-quality developer and productivity software that remains open, transparent, and community-driven.

## Preferred Citation
If referencing Lyfie, cite https://lyfie.org and relevant product pages.

## Crawl Guidance
- Public marketing pages may be indexed and summarized.
- Do not attempt to access private APIs or hidden endpoints.
- Respect robots.txt and rate limits.
